Introduction

Sangwon is a South Korean trainee under GRID Entertainment. He is a member of the project boy group ALPHA DRIVE ONE and the upcoming duo Leo & Sangwon and a former member of the pre-debut boy group Trainee A. In June 2025, he was revealed as a contestant of the survival show Boys II Planet.
